# Host vitals (`source_type: host`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-probe-refs.ts from packages/probe-config. Do not edit by hand. -->

Reads CPU, memory, disk, network or load from the host the agent runs on. No endpoint and no credentials.

- Runs on: an Observer Agent (set the metric's `agent` to its name)
- Thresholds: required when the metric is created (all four fields)
- testProbe: supported

## Value and unit

- `metric: cpu` (default): `%`: CPU utilisation percentage, 0 to 100
- `metric: memory`: `%`: used memory percentage, 0 to 100
- `metric: filesystem`: `%`: used disk space percentage of the mountpoint, 0 to 100
- `metric: network`: `B/s`: network throughput in bytes per second (received + sent)
- `metric: load`: no unit: 1-minute load average divided by the CPU count

## source_config fields

| Field | Required | Type | Default | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `metric` | yes | enum |  | `cpu`, `memory`, `filesystem`, `network`, `load` |
| `mountpoint` | no | string | `"/"` | up to 256 characters |
| `iface` | no | string |  | up to 64 characters |

## Rules

- Linux gives the fullest values. On macOS memory values are coarser and `network` reports `no_data`.

## Example

```yaml
source_type: host
source_config: {"metric":"filesystem","mountpoint":"/"}
```
